field_text_formatted.value: JSON:API links now reach the browser as paths, even when Drupal builds them with a different scheme or host, such as https:// behind a proxy. Client-side navigation stays on your frontend (#833). DruxtSiteMixin also imports in client-side code without pulling Node's fs into the bundle (#545). Thanks to Sebastix for reporting that one.
